description: Ministry of Water Supply - Expansion of Water Treatment Plant under Wakamulla Water Supply Scheme, Kandy North-Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Projects and Construction of Water treatment plant of Gampola Jayamalapura Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It specifically approves the acquisition of immobile properties and servitude rights over specific land parcels described in detailed schedules for water supply projects. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, locations, and claimant information, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters that fall under the Land Gazettes classification.
